title.text: Everything You Need to Run Your Server

header.description: A complete control panel built for Minecraft — manage files, plugins, mods, players, and more without leaving your browser.

cards.title: Live Console
cards.description: Send commands, view live logs, and control server power — all from a responsive in-browser console.

cards.title: File Manager
cards.description: Browse, edit, upload, and download server files with a clean folder view — no FTP client required.

cards.title: Plugin Installer
cards.description: Install popular Paper and Spigot plugins in one click from trusted sources, with version matching built in.

cards.title: Mod Manager
cards.description: Search, pick, and install Forge and Fabric mods without hunting down jar files manually.

cards.title: Modpack Manager
cards.description: Deploy full modpacks with dependencies handled automatically — ideal for modded communities.

cards.title: Datapack Manager
cards.description: Enable, disable, and organize Minecraft datapacks directly from the panel — no manual world editing.

cards.title: Version Changer
cards.description: Switch Minecraft versions and server software in a few clicks — Paper, Purpur, Forge, and more.

cards.title: Server Importer
cards.description: Migrate worlds, plugins, and configs from another host or a local backup without complex setup.

cards.title: Player Manager
cards.description: View online players, manage bans, ops, and whitelists — keep your community under control.

cards.title: Subdomains
cards.description: Create free subdomains and connect them to your server instantly for easy player access.
